text: Bitcoin is holding steady near $77k with minimal movement, while Ethereum is outpacing it with a 3.2% gain, suggesting selective strength in altcoins despite Bitcoin's dominance holding firm at 58%. The Fear & Greed index sits in greed territory but has retreated 18 points over the week, indicating some caution is creeping back into sentiment after recent optimism. Volume remains solid at $109B, though the divergence between BTC's flatness and ETH's gains points to traders rotating into alternative exposure rather than broad-market conviction.
